bio: Aratax is a predator – a nightmare stalker. The Voidstormers once found themselves hunted in their dreams, and as Aratax grew closer every night, the leaders performed a Titan Rite to forge something to defeat this horror. Instead, they invoked the horror itself – and now it is theirs to harness.
